description: This file defines device-specific build configurations for the Target Linux build system, including kernel image parameters, device identifiers, and associated packages for different evaluation boards based on the Airoha AN7583 platform.

methods.name: Device/FitImageLzma
methods.description: Defines the parameters for building a fit image with lzma compression, including kernel suffix and the kernel build pipeline.

methods.name: Device/airoha_an7583-evb
methods.description: Defines configuration parameters specific to the AN7583 evaluation board with SNAND, including device information, kernel load address, packages, and device tree source.

methods.name: Device/airoha_an7583-evb-emmc
methods.description: Defines configuration parameters for the EMMC variant of the AN7583 evaluation board, including device info and packages.
